content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-p01-h78b20qi/report.rdl

`DateFrom` and `DateTo` are now typed as DateTime, so Report Builder and the report viewer will show calendar date pickers instead of free-text boxes. The file validates, and the remaining warnings were already there and are unrelated.

One thing to know before you preview: DataSet1's DAX doesn't reference `@DateFrom` or `@DateTo` at all. The pickers will appear, but choosing dates won't filter the data until the query uses them. I didn't add that filter because you only asked for the picker change. If you want it, I can add the two parameters to the query and filter `Usage[ReportDate]` between them.
